description: This file defines the class `ParagraphElements`, a collection class that manages a list of paragraph objects such as text, characters, hyperlinks, fields, bookmarks, images, etc., within a paragraph in the MigraDoc document object model. It provides methods for adding various types of inline elements to a paragraph, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: ParagraphElements
classes.description: A collection class for managing individual paragraph objects like texts, characters, hyperlinks, bookmarks, and more within a paragraph.

classes.name: ParagraphElements.Revisions.ParagraphElementsValues
classes.description: Internal class for managing the internal nullable values for properties of the `ParagraphElements` class.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ParagraphElements collection.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Adds text to the paragraph, splitting by newlines and tabs, creating Text objects accordingly.

methods.name: AddChar
methods.description: Adds a single character or a repeated sequence of characters to the paragraph.

methods.name: AddCharacter
methods.description: Adds a Character object with specified symbol type and count.

methods.name: AddSpace
methods.description: Adds a space character multiple times.

methods.name: AddFormattedText
methods.description: Adds formatted text, with various overloads for formatting options, font, and text.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Adds hyperlinks with different configurations including internal bookmark, external URL, file, or embedded document.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Inserts a bookmark in the paragraph.

methods.name: AddNumPagesField
methods.description: Adds a total number of pages field.

methods.name: AddDateField
methods.description: Adds a date field, optionally with a specified format.

methods.name: AddInfoField
methods.description: Adds an info field of a specified type.

methods.name: AddFootnote
methods.description: Adds a footnote with specified text or empty.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image object by name.
